rows.grounds: compound epithet: slayer of durga-daityas and protector
compound epithet: intoxicated or exulting in the blood of durga-daityas

items.question: What protective and fierce attributes define the goddess in relation to fortress-demons?
premises: The goddess is identified as a protector who slays fortress-demons.
The goddess is identified as intoxicated by the blood of fortress-demons.
These epithets attribute both safeguarding and ferocious power to the goddess.
items.inference: Therefore the goddess unites protective action with fierce destruction against fortress-demons.
uncertainties: The precise referent of durga in durga-daitya remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: She is the protector who slays the fortress-demons, and she is intoxicated with the blood of the fortress-demons.
